name: Combined Sampling (Occupancy Grid + Proposal Network)
definition: A method that stacks an occupancy grid on top of a proposal network to reduce the number of rays and shrink the near-far plane for remaining rays, leveraging the transmittance estimation from both.
summary: Combined sampling accelerates volume rendering by stacking an occupancy grid on a proposal network to prune empty rays and shrink near-far bounds, decoupling spatial sparsity estimation from density prediction.
